description:
Title: Service for Your Fridge

Your fridge produces strange noises.
You describe the symptoms, and send them together with the type of fridge to the central fridge service center.
They select a local service facility (which all have their own way of interacting with customers).
The service facility makes an appointment.
They arrive at a random time, and sometimes have to leave without repairing your fridge, because they need additional parts.
After your fridge is repaired, you have to confirm that it is OK again.
You can rate the service facility.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_FridgeService" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/fridge-service">

  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Symptoms" name="Symptoms and fridge type"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ServiceRequest" name="Service request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Appointment" name="Appointment"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_RepairCompleted" name="Repair completed"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_FridgeService">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Center" name="Central fridge service center" processRef="Process_Center"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Facility" name="Local service facility" processRef="Process_Facility"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Symptoms" name="Send symptoms and fridge type" sourceRef="SendTask_SendSymptoms" targetRef="MsgStart_Symptoms" messageRef="Msg_Symptoms"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ServiceRequest" name="Forward service request" sourceRef="SendTask_ForwardRequest" targetRef="MsgStart_Request" messageRef="Msg_ServiceRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Appointment" name="Send appointment" sourceRef="SendTask_SendAppointment" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_Appointment" messageRef="Msg_Appointment"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_RepairCompleted" name="Notify repair completed" sourceRef="SendTask_NotifyRepaired" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_Repaired" messageRef="Msg_RepairCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <!-- Customer -->
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Noise" name="Fridge produces strange noises"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_DescribeSymptoms" name="Describe symptoms"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendSymptoms" name="Send symptoms and fridge type"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_Appointment" name="Appointment received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Appointment" messageRef="Msg_Appointment"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_Repaired" name="Repair completed received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_RepairCompleted" messageRef="Msg_RepairCompleted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_ConfirmRepair" name="Confirm fridge works again"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RateFacility" name="Rate service facility?"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_RateFacility" name="Rate service facility"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Rated" name="Service rated"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Completed" name="Repair confirmed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Noise" targetRef="Task_DescribeSymptoms"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C2" sourceRef="Task_DescribeSymptoms" targetRef="SendTask_SendSymptoms"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C3" sourceRef="SendTask_SendSymptoms" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_Appointment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C4" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_Appointment" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_Repaired"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C5" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_Repaired" targetRef="UserTask_ConfirmRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C6" sourceRef="UserTask_ConfirmRepair" targetRef="Gateway_RateFacility"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C7" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RateFacility" targetRef="UserTask_RateFacility">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${wantsToRate}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C8" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RateFacility" targetRef="EndEvent_Completed">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${!wantsToRate}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C9" sourceRef="UserTask_RateFacility" targetRef="EndEvent_Rated"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <!-- Central service center -->
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Center" name="Central fridge service center" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="MsgStart_Symptoms" name="Symptoms received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Symptoms" messageRef="Msg_Symptoms"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectFacility" name="Select local service facility"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ForwardRequest" name="Forward request to service facility"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Forwarded" name="Request forwarded"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Ce1" sourceRef="MsgStart_Symptoms" targetRef="Task_SelectFacility"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Ce2" sourceRef="Task_SelectFacility" targetRef="SendTask_ForwardRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Ce3" sourceRef="SendTask_ForwardRequest" targetRef="EndEvent_Forwarded"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <!-- Local service facility -->
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Facility" name="Local service facility" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="MsgStart_Request" name="Service request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Request" messageRef="Msg_ServiceRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MakeAppointment" name="Make appointment"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendAppointment" name="Send appointment to customer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ArrivalMerge" name="Arrival merge"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Arrive" name="Arrive at customer at random time"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RepairPossible" name="Repair possible without additional parts?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Repair" name="Repair fridge"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LeaveWithoutRepair" name="Leave without repairing"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_NotifyRepaired" name="Notify repair completed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Repaired" name="Fridge repaired"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F1" sourceRef="MsgStart_Request" targetRef="Task_MakeAppointment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F2" sourceRef="Task_MakeAppointment" targetRef="SendTask_SendAppointment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F3" sourceRef="SendTask_SendAppointment" targetRef="Gateway_ArrivalMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F4" sourceRef="Gateway_ArrivalMerge" targetRef="Task_Arrive"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F5" sourceRef="Task_Arrive" targetRef="Gateway_RepairPossible"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F6" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairPossible" targetRef="Task_Repair">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${repairPossible}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F7" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairPossible" targetRef="Task_LeaveWithoutRepair">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${!repairPossible}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F8" sourceRef="Task_LeaveWithoutRepair" targetRef="Gateway_ArrivalMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F9" sourceRef="Task_Repair" targetRef="SendTask_NotifyRepaired"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_F10" sourceRef="SendTask_NotifyRepaired" targetRef="EndEvent_Repaired"/>
  </bpmn:process>

</bpmn:definitions>
